about: I am a Ph.D. student in mathematics at Peking University, based at the Beijing International Center for Mathematical Research (BICMR).
I am interested in the representation theory of p-adic groups, the Langlands program, and ℓ-independence.

papers.title: Enhanced Langlands Parameters of Regular Principal Series
papers.authors: Haoming Li, Xiaohang Yang, Jizhi Zhang, and Yelei Zhao
papers.description: We describe the enhanced Langlands parameters of irreducible constituents of regular principal series for quasi-split reductive groups over non-archimedean local fields of characteristic zero, prove that their enhancements are trivial, and identify the parameter of the unique irreducible subrepresentation.
